options.name: advertise_subnets
options.description: Advertise EVPN subnets if you have silent hosts.

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_HOST) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_otp
options.description: Specify the OTP. Uses the E(PROXMOX_OTP) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Specify the target port of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PORT) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Time limit for requests towards the Proxmox VE API.

options.name: api_token_id
options.description: Specify the token ID. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_token_secret
options.description: Specify the token secret. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_USER) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: bridge
options.description: Specify the bridge interface to use.

options.name: bridge_disable_mac_learning
options.description: Disable auto MAC address learning on the bridge interface.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to a local certificate, which will be used to verify TLS connections. Ignored if O(validate_certs=false).

options.name: controller
options.description: FRR router name.

options.name: dhcp
options.description: Type of the DHCP backend for this zone.

options.name: disable_arp_nd_suppression
options.description: Disable IPv4 ARP and IPv6 neighbour discovery suppression.

options.name: dns
options.description: DNS API server.

options.name: dnszone
options.description: DNS domain zone.

options.name: dp_id
options.description: Faucet dataplane ID.

options.name: exitnodes
options.description: List of cluster node names.

options.name: exitnodes_local_routing
options.description: Allow exitnodes to connect to EVPN guests.

options.name: exitnodes_primary
options.description: Force traffic to this exit node first.

options.name: fabric
options.description: SDN fabric to use as underlay for this VXLAN zone. Either O(fabric) or O(peers) is required for VXLAN zones.

options.name: ipam
options.description: Use a specific IPAM.

options.name: mac
options.description: Anycast logical router MAC address.

options.name: mtu
options.description: Set the Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU).

options.name: nodes
options.description: List of cluster node names.

options.name: peers
options.description: Peers address list (comma-separated IP addresses). Either O(fabric) or O(peers) is required for VXLAN zones. Example: 192.168.0.1,192.168.0.2,192.168.0.3

options.name: reversedns
options.description: Reverse DNS API server.

options.name: rt_import
options.description: Route-Target import.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the zone configuration.

options.name: tag
options.description: Service-VLAN tag.

options.name: type
options.description: Specify the type of zone.

options.name: update
options.description: If O(state=present) and zone exists it'll update.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate the TLS certificates used for the connection to the Proxmox VE API. May be set through the environment variable E(PROXMOX_VALIDATE_CERTS).

options.name: vlan_protocol
options.description: Specify the VLAN protocol to use.

options.name: vrf_vxlan
options.description: Specify the VRF VXLAN identifier.

options.name: vxlan_port
options.description: VXLAN tunnel UDP port (default 4789).

options.name: zone
options.description: Unique zone name.
